description: This file defines the CppBmmTemplate class, a Python class that generates C++ code for batch matrix multiplication (BMM) kernels. It includes template strings for defining single-threaded and multi-threaded GEMM kernels, methods for code generation, and configurations for handling batch dimensions.

classes.name: CppBmmTemplate
classes.description: A Python class that generates C++ code templates for batch matrix multiplication (BMM) kernels, supporting single and multi-threaded execution with configurable options for block sizes, data types, and batching.

methods.description: Prepares and returns a dictionary of options for code generation, including tensor buffers, data types, batch size, and kernel parameters.

methods.description: Renders the complete code for the BMM operation using the template strings and current options, including hooks for defining GEMM routines.
